# `RestartGuide`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Imager restarts guiding after a goto or a retry.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, StartGuideFunc @0x17a110 (64-bit build); 32-bit counterpart present |

S family, emitted by the imager (not forwarded from the guider). The imager's start-guide worker reports start, complete or fail when it restarts guiding after a goto or on retry. error and code only for a supplied code greater than zero. Broadcast on TCP 4700 to every retained socket. The app defines the name as a constant but no event branch handling it is established. A 32-bit counterpart exists.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"RestartGuide"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Legacy literal. One of: `start`, `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if caller-supplied code > 0 | - | Message for code. The S helper writes it only when the caller supplies a code greater than zero. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if caller-supplied code > 0 | - | Written only when the caller supplies a code greater than zero; never written as 0 by this helper. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, start - Restart begins (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"RestartGuide","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start"}
```

Event, complete - Guiding restarted (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"RestartGuide","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete"}
```
